toegepas.blok: Die oomblikke waarop die storie draai
toegepas.rede_vinder: 'Werk vir' calques English 'work for'; 'geld vir' is the idiomatic Afrikaans for 'apply to', same word count.
toegepas.fout: 'werk vir' copies English 'work for' where Afrikaans says 'geld vir'
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'Geld vir' is the natural Afrikaans for 'apply to' and keeps the meaning that the viewing points serve drama in every medium listed.

toegepas.voor: 'n Haan wat kraai kan jou op 'n plaas laat voel.
toegepas.na: 'n Haan wat kraai, kan jou laat voel jy is op 'n plaas.
toegepas.rede_vinder: 'Jou op 'n plaas laat voel' is an English-shaped construction; 'laat voel jy is op 'n plaas' is natural Afrikaans, and AWS puts a comma where the verbs of the relative clause and the main clause meet ('kraai, kan').
toegepas.fout: 'jou op 'n plaas laat voel' is an English-shaped construction
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'Laat voel jy is op 'n plaas' is natural Afrikaans with the same meaning, and the comma where the two clauses' verbs meet follows AWS.

toegepas.rede_vinder: An ordinal joined to a superlative is written as one word in Afrikaans (as in 'tweedebeste').
toegepas.fout: ordinal plus superlative written as two words; Afrikaans writes 'tweedehoogste' as one
toegepas.rede_keurder: A plain spelling fix in a glossary entry with no change to meaning, applied together with change 8 so the voice-part entries stay parallel.

toegepas.fout: ordinal plus superlative written as two words; Afrikaans writes 'tweedelaagste' as one
toegepas.rede_keurder: A plain spelling fix in a glossary entry with no change to meaning, applied together with change 7 so the voice-part entries stay parallel.

laat_vaar.rede_vinder: 'Daarom ... daar' doubles the reference to the radio drama and reads clumsily; 'Daarom' already carries it, and a word is saved.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: 'Daar' ties the sound effects to the radio drama; without it the sentence reads as a general claim, so information is lost and the original reads acceptably.

laat_vaar.rede_vinder: 'maar nie vir 'n kultuur nie' has no subject and verb of its own and joins a command, so under AWS 2017 it takes no comma.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: A contrastive comma before 'maar' is normal Afrikaans practice and helps the Grade 5 reader; the never-a-comma rule applies to 'en', so removing it is not an improvement.

laat_vaar.rede_vinder: 'Met oefen' uses a bare verb as a noun after a preposition; 'deur oefening' is the correct and natural form, same word count.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: The preposition change moves the meaning from what changed while they rehearsed to what changed because of rehearsing, and 'met oefen' is acceptable Afrikaans.

na_skrywer.rede_vinder: 'Manier van lewe' calques 'way of life'; 'leefwyse' is the standard Afrikaans word and saves two words.
na_skrywer.fout: 'manier van lewe' is a calque of English 'way of life' where Afrikaans has 'leefwyse'
na_skrywer.rede_keurder: The fix is a real improvement but it rewords a glossary definition beyond spelling or grammar, so the writer must make it for every lesson that carries this entry.
na_skrywer.waarom: the reviewer sent it to the writer

vlae.teks: Sinne vol amper eenderse klanke wat moeilik is om vinnig te sê.
vlae.rede: The relative clause 'wat moeilik is om vinnig te sê' can attach to 'klanke' instead of 'Sinne'; untangling it would add words to a lesson near its ceiling, so it is left for the reviewer or writer to judge.
